title: COUNT counts direct logicals, omitted slots, and yearless date text, ignores references inside arrays, and reads through nested arrays
statement: In Excel 16.0 builds 20430 and 20527, COUNT(value1, [value2], ...) counts numbers in held ranges and counts direct numbers, logicals, omitted arguments, and text that parses as a number or date (including yearless date text such as "1/2", whereas "1/2/2020" is 0 under en-ZA DMY settings), ignores text/logicals/blanks/errors in cell ranges, does not count references inside array results (=COUNT(OFFSET(Data!E1,@{0,1,2},0)) -> 0, or 1 for scalar @), and flattens arrays held inside arrays (e.g. GROUPBY results). Matches 1,212/1,212 full-bank and 120/120 pinned COUNT rows.
basis: Measured across Excel 16.0 build 20430 (1,212/1,212 full-bank and 120/120 pinned COUNT rows in witnesses/COUNT.json) and Excel 16.0.20527.20088 in dch9u_functions (rows 88-89, 2066, 2099, 2107) and dcb1l_language (rows 101, 129).
